title: myOrbit: Mobile
summary: Compressing myOrbit's dense, multi-panel relationship graph into something that still works on a phone, without losing the information a therapist or client actually needs at a glance.
role: Solo full-stack engineer, contracted via Castle Logic LLC for EmmeCo — built using agentic engineering workflows
problem: myOrbit's graph view was designed desktop-first, with several panels visible at once. On mobile, that had to consolidate into something that still surfaces the same information without overwhelming a small screen.
